{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
ctrl_moderate = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the size of the filtered group
n_ctrl_moderate = len(ctrl_moderate)

# Count how many responded
n_responded = ctrl_moderate['responded'].sum()

# Calculate the fraction
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_ctrl_moderate

print(f"Number of CONTROL-arm, MODERATE-severity patients: {n_ctrl_moderate}")
print(f"Number who responded: {n_responded}")
print(f"Fraction who responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
